title: Bind admitted R437 q127 root Count to initial NODE consumers
body:
The existing R437 sharp entry validates host parameters, while the local batched quotient has not been joined to an admitted root's actual binary Count and caller consumers. This package completes that join at q=2^127−1, e=n=64,w=2,h=0 and exact L255/I8/Q520213: the original authenticated entry encodes the real 1,040,413-bit root stock, executes the opt-in quotient, literal NODE ingress and 9475 guard, saves leading, and executes the initial `fibre=Count.product(leading,gap)`. All three observed outputs are 9475.

The full pre-payload diagnostic reached original `multiply_atom_power` but exceeded its external 90-second budget. Its exact harness remains in commit `5fc3091bf853b9f19a155e03ce0750a2104dc135`; DIAGNOSTIC.json preserves the 90.505-second interruption and phases. The successful current projection keeps all 17 original NODE statements through the first fibre product and appends an explicit ownership return. It stops before exponent expansion. The original next segment still requires 256 Word divisions and 256 Count multiplications, eventually a 32,526-bit fibre. No final fibre, complete NODE, full Context, payload or supplier execution is claimed.

The returned local Count is explicitly disposed before testing source temporary cleanup. Actual borrowed Program/count bytes and heads, dirty Count173/Word37, numerical live sets and erased record backing pass; wrong precision/index/Q/rows/history/source identity reject before the continuation. Runtime Word decoding is forbidden. The 56.311-second successful q127 run uses no tiny replacement witness.

The invoice includes full source construction/execution/disposal and distinct NODE lane counters, plus 3,122,293 visited record cells. The batch divisor has 520,192 bits; its 13 host construction products have 90,200,420,437 schoolbook bit-products. Those diagnostics do not price the full compiler, large-divisor host arithmetic, finite control, allocator or physical binary-TM tariff. No uniform performance improvement follows.

Credit David Arias #2753, Chris R / Clear1nsight #4176, #4794 `4cc9b9719fdab59f0f33243b9c323fe4d69346f5`, Nick Petalas #4854 `2877e4920338d9a2e56aa960bdb5663f8f96b2d8`, codyw912 #4734, ToikY #4025 and the pinned stock/compiler lineage. Discussion #4927 independently audits complete-directory reserve; this package neither repeats it nor treats its payload/lifetime assumptions as discharged. New composition and checks: JoyboyBrian, substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, Apache-2.0.

Validation: actual q127 exact replay; package metadata; committed-byte/source-history preflight at canonical base `b91956876e5b4122fd89179f1b57557ff8378f15` (413 files, no foreign source ancestor); official export and integrity check. Git-free cold normal/optimized replays pass (55.993s/55.552s), with empty bytecode caches. Generic live and retained-source corruptions reject, as do explicit mutations of the newly composed #4794 quotient and #4757 ordinal inputs. A bool→int RESULT mutation rejects at typed comparison after replay. All 414 cold export files restore unchanged. The affected-package planner selects only this package. Hosted CI is unverified.

Canonical investigation and documented scope change: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4682#discussioncomment-19138327 . Only `research/r437-admitted-count-consumer/` changes, with four substantive commits preserving the initial interface, measured full-path diagnostic, narrowed checked boundary and final evidence. Open next questions retain the original expansion, complete physical cost, Context and payload obligations.

Final submission checkpoint: official main refreshed at 05:13 UTC remains `b91956876e5b4122fd89179f1b57557ff8378f15`; guidance and affected source inputs are unchanged. Fresh overlap covers 323 open PRs (05:14:01 UTC), 4,077 discussion records (05:14:50 UTC), and all 6,636 current-base notes. The scoped final query identifies the credited distinct predecessor obligations and this round's claims, not an exhaustive novelty certificate. Root independently read the authenticated AST projection, original checked_entry continuation, actual runtime methods, disposal checks and exact excluded expansion/cost obligations, with no blocker.
